verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth is an auth product, so acting as a spec-compliant OAuth authorization server for an MCP server is a fair question. The evidence only shows Supabase consuming OAuth (social/custom providers), issuing its own JWTs with a JWKS URL, and customizing token claims. None of it documents Supabase acting as an OAuth authorization server that third-party agents can register with and get scoped tokens from, and no MCP auth flow is mentioned. JWKS, custom claims and RLS scoping are only building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can put a spec-compliant OAuth authorization flow in front of my MCP server so remote agents connect with scoped, verifiable tokens
